items.title: 白宮加大施壓力道！美副總統范斯：Fed理當降息 讓百姓買得起房
items.title_en: White House Steps Up Pressure! Vice President Farris Says Fed Should Cut Rates to Make Homes Affordable
paras: 美國副總統范斯週四(3日)表示，聯準會(Fed)應下調利率來減輕民眾的購屋壓力，此舉進一步強化白宮向Fed施壓、要求降低借貸成本的力度。
范斯在白宮記者會上發表上述言論之際，正值美國總統川普親自挑選的Fed主席華許恐將反其道而行。
當被問及川普政府對近期美國債市波動的看法時，范斯說：「顯然，總統非常關注利率問題。他之所以如此關注，主要原因之一是希望美國民眾能買得起房。利率一旦走高，借貸成本也會隨之上升。」
范斯還說，「我們認為Fed理應降息」，並稱這是應對近期美國通膨數據的「合理且負責任」的做法。
他並表示，川普政府正採取多項措施試圖壓低利率，但如果Fed能幫個忙，那就再好不過了。
范斯發言恐加劇外界對Fed在川普治下獨立性受損的擔憂。此前，川普曾極力施壓Fed前主席鮑爾大幅降息，目前仍在試圖解僱聯準會理事庫克。
華許上周五(8月28日)在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會上表示，他致力於將通膨率降至聯準會2%的目標水平，並認為利率是實現這一目標的關鍵工具。這番言論被視為鷹派發言，令市場上升息預期升溫，升息機率重新佔上風。
Fed理事巴爾本周二(1日)也表示，若通膨持續居高不下，他已準備好支持升息。
然而，隨著更多重量級聯準會官員發表講話，Fed本月是否會升息，又出現了新的疑問。Fed理事華勒周四(3日)意外釋放強力鴿派訊號。華勒表示，若即將公佈的數據確認通膨壓力正在降溫，他傾向支持9月按兵不動。
根據芝加哥商品交易所(CME)FedWatch數據，交易員認為Fed在9月15日至16日會議上升息與按兵不動的機率幾乎五五開，本週稍早升息機率曾一度高達近70%。
隨著市場對升息預期再度回落，美債殖利率周四進一步回落，接下來投資人將密切關注周五(4日)公佈的非農就業報告，繼續尋找Fed未來利率路徑的線索。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President Farris said on Thursday (the 3rd) that the Federal Reserve should lower interest rates to ease the public’s housing‑buying pressure, further intensifying the White House’s push on the Fed to reduce borrowing costs.
Farris made the remarks at a White House press briefing just as President Trump‑chosen Fed Chair Whitaker appears poised to take the opposite approach.

When asked about the Trump administration’s view on recent volatility in the U.S. bond market, Farris said, “Obviously the President is very concerned about rates. One of the main reasons is that he wants Americans to be able to afford a home. When rates rise, borrowing costs rise as well.”
Farris added, “We believe the Fed ought to cut rates,” calling it a “reasonable and responsible” response to the latest U.S. inflation data.
He said the Trump administration is already taking multiple steps to try to push rates lower, and it would be even better if the Fed could lend a hand.

Farris’s comments could heighten concerns about the Fed’s independence under Trump. Previously, Trump heavily pressured former Fed Chair Powell to cut rates dramatically and is still attempting to fire Fed Governor Cook.

Whitaker told the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last Friday (Aug. 28) that he is committed to bringing inflation down to the Fed’s 2% target and sees interest rates as the key tool, a hawkish stance that has revived market expectations of rate hikes.
Fed Governor Barl said on Tuesday (the 1st) that if inflation remains stubbornly high, he is ready to support another rate increase.

However, as more senior Fed officials speak, new questions arise about whether the Fed will hike this month. Fed Governor Wheeler on Thursday (the 3rd) unexpectedly sent a strong dovish signal, saying that if upcoming data confirm inflation pressures are easing, he leans toward holding rates steady in September.

According to CME FedWatch data, traders see the odds of a rate hike versus a hold at the September 15‑16 meeting as roughly 50‑50, after the probability of a hike earlier this week briefly spiked to nearly 70%.

With market expectations for a hike receding, U.S. Treasury yields fell further on Thursday, and investors will now watch Friday’s (the 4th) non‑farm payroll report closely for clues on the Fed’s future rate path.

items.title: SpaceX市值重返2兆美元大關！AI基礎設施強勢發威 專家讚上漲空間50%
items.title_en: SpaceX's Market Value Returns to the $2 Trillion Mark! AI Infrastructure Shows Strong Momentum, Experts Praise 50% Upside Potential
paras: 睽違兩個月，SpaceX市值終於重返2兆美元，顯示這檔股票在公開市場經歷初期劇烈波動後，已重新獲得投資人青睞。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(3日)上漲6.4%至每股149.74美元，盤中一度突破150美元，為7月10日以來首見。以收盤價計算，SpaceX市值略高於2兆美元，是自7月6日以來首次重返2兆美元。
目前美國僅少數企業市值超過2兆美元，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)。
SpaceX股價反彈之際，分析師持續看好其上漲潛力，而美國股市整體走強，也為股價提供支撐。根據FactSet數據，SpaceX平均目標價為225.87美元，與目前股價相比仍有約50%的上漲空間。
近來也有多名分析師重申對SpaceX的正面評等，例如Oppenheimer分析師Timothy Horan認為，在目前人工智慧(AI)資源供應短缺的環境下，SpaceX將成為主要受惠者。他也表示，隨著SpaceX開發功能更強大的AI模型，相關AI營收的成長速度快於市場預期。
Horan周三維持SpaceX「買進」評等，並表示，SpaceX「有能力比任何人更快建置基礎設施，並利用這些基礎設施及數據，以比任何人更快的速度改善自身模型」。

特斯拉同步大漲 Cybercab將整合Starlink

同在馬斯克麾下的特斯拉(TSLA-US)，周四也勁揚5.4%，投資人正準備迎接Cybercab自駕計程車發表活動。
由於兩家公司關係密切，SpaceX可能也會在周四的活動中扮演角色。馬斯克今年7月曾向投資人表示，SpaceX旗下衛星網路服務星鏈(Starlink)將整合至Cybercab。
他表示，這將有助於特斯拉避免車輛失去連線，否則可能出現「無法追蹤、失去聯繫的自駕計程車」。這項連線功能也可用於娛樂用途。
馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示：「如果人們坐在車裡，他們可能想做一些高效率的事情，或是想要娛樂。有了Starlink，你可以在車內觀看4K高畫質直播體育賽事。」
輝達(NVDA-US)在內的大型科技股周四也走高，並帶動Roundhill「科技七巨頭」ETF(MAGS-US)逼近歷史收盤高點。根據道瓊市場數據，該ETF終場距離5月14日創下的70.94美元歷史收盤高點不到1個百分點。
paras_en: After a two‑month hiatus, SpaceX's market value finally returned to $2 trillion, indicating that the stock, after experiencing sharp early‑stage volatility in the public market, has regained investors' favor.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) shares rose 6.4% on Thursday the 3rd to $149.74 per share, briefly breaking the $150 level intraday for the first time since July 10. At the close, SpaceX’s market cap was just above $2 trillion, marking the first return to that level since July 6.
Only a handful of U.S. companies now have market caps above $2 trillion, including Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US).

As SpaceX’s stock rebounds, analysts remain bullish on its upside, and the overall strength of the U.S. equity market also supports the price. FactSet data shows an average target price of $225.87 for SpaceX, implying roughly a 50% upside from the current price.

Several analysts have recently reiterated positive ratings on SpaceX. Oppenheimer analyst Timothy Horan believes that, amid the current shortage of AI resources, SpaceX will be a primary beneficiary. He also notes that as SpaceX develops more powerful AI models, its AI‑related revenue growth is outpacing market expectations.

Horan maintained a “Buy” rating on SpaceX on Wednesday, stating that SpaceX “has the ability to build infrastructure faster than anyone and to use that infrastructure and data to improve its models at a speed no one else can match.”
Tesla (TSLA‑US), also led by Musk, surged 5.4% on Thursday as investors gear up for the Cybercab autonomous‑taxi launch event.

Because the two companies are closely linked, SpaceX may also play a role in Thursday’s event. In July, Musk told investors that SpaceX’s satellite‑internet service Starlink would be integrated into Cybercab.

He said this would help Tesla avoid losing connectivity in its vehicles, which could otherwise result in “untrackable, disconnected autonomous taxis.” The connectivity feature could also be used for entertainment purposes.

Musk said during the earnings call, “If people are sitting in the car, they might want to do something productive or be entertained. With Starlink, you can watch 4K high‑definition live sports inside the vehicle.”

Large‑cap tech stocks, including Nvidia (NVDA‑US), rose on Thursday, pulling the Roundhill “Tech Seven Giants” ETF (MAGS‑US) close to its historical closing high. According to Dow Jones market data, the ETF finished less than one percent away from its May 14 record high of $70.94.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab 將首次在中國公開亮相
items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab to make its first public debut in China
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 3日（周四）宣布，賽博無人駕駛電動車Cybercab正式在美國奧斯汀投入營運。
此外，Cybercab將於9月中旬開始在北京、上海等多座城市展出，是首次在中國公開亮相。
據《證券時報》4日報導，此次活動旨在展示其產品設計與技術理念，不涉及Cybercab在中國市場上市銷售或無人駕駛叫車商業營運安排。
paras_en: U.S. electric vehicle giant Tesla (TSLA-US) announced on Thursday the 3rd that its autonomous electric vehicle Cybercab has officially begun operations in Austin, USA.
In addition, the Cybercab will be exhibited in Beijing, Shanghai and several other cities starting mid‑September, marking its first public appearance in China.

According to the Securities Times on the 4th, the event is intended to showcase its product design and technology concepts and does not involve the Cybercab’s market launch, sales, or autonomous ride‑hailing commercial operations in China.

paras: 瞄準國人多元資產配置需求，街口投信將推出00992B街口特選優息非投資等級債券ETF(基金之配息來源可能為收益平準金且並無保證收益及配息)，鎖定存續期限1至5年的短天期債券，同時導入雙重分散與信用預警機制，力求兼顧收益機會與投資組合風險控管。預計9月14日展開募集，發行價格為新台幣10元，並採月配息機制，滿足投資人現金流規劃需求。
近年國人「存債」熱度持續升溫，根據投信投顧公會資料，截至2026年7月底，國內債券ETF規模達2.85兆元，較2022年底的1.21兆元成長約135%；受益人數更由15.1萬人攀升至142.5萬人，增幅達843%，不到四年間成長逾8倍，反映債券ETF已成為投資人打造現金流及分散資產配置的重要工具。
各類債券中，非投資等級債具有存續期短的特性，受利率波動影響較輕，有助於穿越景氣與利率循環，街口投信分析，根據彭博統計過去25年多次升、降息循環，無論處於「升息循環至降息前」或「降息循環至升息前」階段，非投資等級債報酬表現多優於投資級公司債、政府債券及新興市場債券。
除了利率敏感度較低，較高票息也有助於持續挹注收益，隨投資期間拉長，非投資等級債累積報酬效果更為明顯。根據彭博統計近26年ICE美銀主要債券指數表現，美國非投資等級債累積報酬達426.89%，高於美國新興市場債券的278.57%、美國投資級公司債券的258.89%，以及全球政府債券的110.85%，長期報酬表現相對突出。
看好非投資等級債券收益潛力，街口投信推出00992B街口特選優息非投資等級債券ETF(基金之配息來源可能為收益平準金且並無保證收益及配息)，追蹤「ICE TPEx 1-5年期已開發市場高票息美元非投資等級債券指數」，鎖定存續期限1至5年的非投資等級債券，以「短天期、高票息」為主要選債特色，透過縮短存續期間降低利率波動影響，同時掌握非投資等級債券的高收益機會。
不過，非投資等級債券在追求收益的同時，也須留意信用風險。00992B追蹤指數因此從「分散」與「信用監控」兩方面著手，其中單一產業配置上限為10%、單一發行人上限為2%，避免部位過度集中於特定產業或企業，分散單一信用事件對投資組合的衝擊。
另一方面，指數同步導入信用監控與動態剔除機制，持續檢視成分債信用品質。若債券信評於3個月、6個月或1年期間內連續遭調降2個評等，即觸發自動排除機制，提前剔除信用狀況惡化的標的，強化投資組合的信用風險控管。
展望非投資等級債後市，街口投信認為，在企業獲利與財務體質維持韌性、違約率處於相對低檔下，基本面尚屬穩健；加上目前收益水準極具吸引力，值此股市高檔震盪之際，投資人可適度納入非投資等級債券，藉由固定收益資產分散股市波動風險，同時兼顧收益機會。
在投資布局上，街口投信進一步建議，可以聚焦「重收益、控波動、挑信用」三大方向。由於全球利率仍可能受到通膨、財政政策及地緣政治等因素干擾，若債券天期過長，價格較容易受到市場利率變動影響；相較之下，短天期債券的利率敏感度較低，再搭配具有穩定現金流及償債能力的發債企業，有助在爭取收益的同時，降低利率及信用市場波動對投資組合的影響。

It will focus on short‑term bonds with maturities of 1‑5 years, and will incorporate dual diversification and credit‑alert mechanisms to balance yield opportunities with portfolio risk control. The offering is slated to start on September 14 at an issue price of NT$10, with monthly distributions to meet investors’ cash‑flow planning needs.

In recent years, the “bond‑saving” craze among Taiwanese has continued to heat up. According to data from the Investment Trust Association, as of the end of July 2026 domestic bond‑ETF assets reached NT$2.85 trillion, up about 135 % from NT$1.21 trillion at the end of 2022. The number of beneficiaries rose from 151,000 to 1.425 million, an increase of 843 %—more than eight‑fold in under four years—showing that bond ETFs have become a key tool for investors to generate cash flow and diversify assets.

Among bond categories, non‑investment‑grade (high‑yield) bonds have short maturities and are less affected by interest‑rate swings, helping them ride through economic and rate cycles. JKOAM’s analysis, based on Bloomberg data covering multiple rate‑hike and rate‑cut cycles over the past 25 years, finds that high‑yield bonds tend to outperform investment‑grade corporates, government bonds and emerging‑market debt whether the market is in a “rate‑hike‑to‑cut” or “rate‑cut‑to‑hike” phase.

Besides lower rate sensitivity, the higher coupons of high‑yield bonds also boost ongoing returns. Over longer holding periods, the cumulative return advantage becomes more pronounced. Bloomberg’s 26‑year performance of the ICE U.S. High‑Yield Index shows a total return of 426.89 %, outpacing U.S. emerging‑market debt (278.57 %), U.S. investment‑grade corporates (258.89 %) and global government bonds (110.85 %).

Seeing the yield potential of high‑yield bonds, JKOAM is launching the 00992B JKOAM Selected High‑Yield Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETF (the fund’s distribution source may be a smoothing reserve and does not guarantee returns or distributions). It will track the “ICE TPEx 1‑5‑Year Developed‑Market High‑Coupon USD High‑Yield Index,” targeting 1‑5‑year non‑investment‑grade bonds with a “short‑term, high‑coupon” selection focus, shortening duration to reduce rate‑risk impact while capturing the high‑yield opportunity.

However, chasing yield with high‑yield bonds also requires attention to credit risk. The 00992B index therefore addresses diversification and credit monitoring: a single‑industry exposure cap of 10 % and a single‑issuer cap of 2 % prevent over‑concentration in any sector or company, mitigating the impact of a single credit event on the portfolio.

The index also incorporates a credit‑monitoring and dynamic exclusion mechanism that continuously reviews the credit quality of constituent bonds. If a bond’s rating is downgraded by two notches within a 3‑month, 6‑month or 1‑year window, an automatic exclusion is triggered, removing deteriorating credits early and strengthening portfolio credit‑risk control.

Looking ahead for high‑yield bonds, JKOAM believes that as long as corporate profitability and financial strength remain resilient and default rates stay relatively low, fundamentals are sound. Coupled with currently attractive yields, investors can modestly add high‑yield bonds during periods of elevated equity‑market volatility to diversify away stock‑market risk while still seeking income.

In terms of portfolio construction, JKOAM further recommends focusing on three pillars: “high yield, low volatility, credit quality.” Because global rates may still be swayed by inflation, fiscal policy and geopolitics, long‑dated bonds are more price‑sensitive to rate moves. By contrast, short‑dated bonds have lower rate sensitivity, and when paired with issuers that have stable cash flow and debt‑servicing capacity, they can help capture yield while dampening the impact of rate and credit‑market volatility on the portfolio.

items.title: 2017年來頭一遭！大摩：今年全球銅礦產量恐下滑 銅價前景獲提振
paras: 過去一年銅價屢創新高，主因是關稅預期催生的搬倉；如今多頭把賭注轉向生產端，因銅礦供應增速近乎停擺。
根據國際銅業研究組織(ICSG)最新數據，今年上半年全球銅礦產量年減1.1%；智利Codelco與Freeport-McMoRan均見兩位數降幅。
今年初，摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)原先估計供應將有所成長，目前則下修為「基本持平或微降」，這意味著全球銅礦可能出現2017年來首度年度下滑。
理論上，高價應誘使礦企增產，但品位下滑、工安事故、專案延誤與極端天氣層層卡關。智利第二大礦商銅產量降至19年來同期新低，Cochilco連兩季下修全年預測至年減 2.6%，Codelco 更坦言連「小幅增長」都難達標。
貝萊德主題投資主管Evy Hambro上月受訪時直言，老礦品位掉、資產老化、新專案斷檔，是銅市「非常、非常緊張」的主要原因。
但精煉銅並未缺貨，市場炒作美國可能對精煉銅加稅，空前規模的銅搬至美國倉庫，區域失衡加劇。這種搬倉屬暫時現象，但生產端制約是結構性的，多頭看好受限的供給終將再推高銅價。
專家指出，短期看，美倉虹吸與智利天氣擾動主導波動；中線來看，大摩翻空、Codelco連降指引，已把「礦緊」寫進定價，而電氣化與AI基礎建設若持續吃銅，價格則將易漲難跌。

items.title: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok一度集體當機 持續近4小時
items.title_en: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Simultaneously Went Offline for Nearly Four Hours
paras: 本次三大AI模型當機時間持續約3小時40分，截至台灣時間4日（周五）凌晨1點10分，所有服務已經恢復，Gemini在這次事件中從未通報服務中斷。
此前，Downdetector上用戶通報以及各公司狀態頁面顯示，多家AI公司的服務中斷。
Anthropic表示，正在調查Claude出現的錯誤，並致力於修復。OpenAI說，ChatGPT和Codex出現問題。SpaceXAI稱，Grok出現故障，正在調查服務中斷。
Downdetector的數據顯示，超過12,000份用戶通報指出OpenAI有問題。關於Claude的問題通報約1,200份。Grok的問題通報約1,000份。
雖然AI服務當機不算罕見，但三家巨頭平台同時出現故障並不尋常。
目前來看，Gemini未受影響。儘管在同一時間段內用戶通報數量有所上升，但Google尚未確認服務中斷。
底層原因可能與微軟(MSFT-US) Azure有關，該平台同樣出現了故障通報激增的情況。這三家AI平台均依賴Azure提供雲端運算服務，不過它們的算力架構中也包含了Google等其他服務商。
paras_en: The three major AI models were down for about 3 hours and 40 minutes; by 1:10 a.m. Taiwan time on the 4th (Friday), all services had been restored, and Gemini did not report any service interruption during this incident.
Previously, user reports on Downdetector and status pages from various companies indicated that several AI services were disrupted.
Anthropic said it was investigating an error with Claude and working to fix it. OpenAI reported issues with ChatGPT and Codex. SpaceXAI stated that Grok had a fault and was investigating the outage.
Downdetector data showed over 12,000 user reports indicating problems with OpenAI. About 1,200 reports concerned Claude, and roughly 1,000 reports were about Grok.
While AI service outages are not uncommon, it is unusual for three major platforms to fail simultaneously.
Gemini appears to have been unaffected. Although the number of user reports increased during the same period, Google has not confirmed a service interruption.

The underlying cause may be related to Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure, which also saw a surge in outage reports. All three AI platforms rely on Azure for cloud computing, though their compute architectures also include other providers such as Google.

items.title: 普丁稱俄烏仍有望達成協議 芝加哥小麥期貨急跌超2%
items.title_en: Putin Says Russia‑Ukraine Still Has Chance to Reach Agreement, Chicago Wheat Futures Plunge Over 2%
paras: 多家外媒報導，俄羅斯總統普丁透露，俄烏兩國仍有機會達成和平協議，市場對黑海穀物出口中斷的擔憂隨之降溫，芝加哥期貨交易所小麥期貨週四 (3 日) 下跌逾 2%，從本週稍早觸及的多年高點回落。
過去一個月，市場擔憂俄羅斯與烏克蘭的黑海穀物出口可能受阻，帶動小麥價格大幅上漲。普丁釋出和平訊號後，部分交易員選擇獲利了結，成為當日小麥期貨下跌的主要原因。
普丁週四在俄羅斯遠東地區舉行的經濟論壇上表示，美國、中國等國都願意協助推動和平進程，俄烏確實存在達成協議的可能性。不過，他強調，這場衝突最終仍須由俄羅斯與烏克蘭共同解決。
同日，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基透露，美國談判代表訪問俄烏兩國的初步日期已經敲定，預計未來幾天分別前往莫斯科與基輔。他表示，美國持續積極參與斡旋，對推動和平進程十分重要。
負責促成俄烏協議的美國特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與川普女婿庫許納 (Jared Kushner)，今年 1 月曾前往莫斯科，但迄今尚未訪問基輔。俄烏雙方上一次參加由美國居中協調的談判是在今年 2 月。
美國總統川普接受英國《GB News》訪問時也表示，他希望俄烏戰爭及雙方傷亡能夠結束，並相信最終可以實現這項目標。川普前一天曾表示，只要普丁準備好談和平，他願意與其舉行峰會。
儘管俄烏雙方罕見對和平前景釋出正面訊號，部分小麥交易員仍保持謹慎，認為普丁的談話並不代表軍事行動即將減少，黑海穀物運輸面臨的實際干擾也沒有改變。
普丁指控，烏克蘭攻擊民用商船，以及基輔要求民航客機避開俄羅斯領空，正使重啟談判變得更加困難。他表示，俄烏目前仍維持接觸，主要透過情報管道進行，但現階段難以判斷這些接觸能否促成和平協議。
隨著雙方加強長程空襲，針對港口與商船的攻擊也明顯升級。
烏克蘭穀物交易商聯盟 (UGA) 週四公布，烏克蘭8月穀物與油籽出口量由7月的250萬公噸降至120萬公噸。
市場目前也在關注沙烏地阿拉伯週四公布的小麥進口招標，以及各國供應商的回應。俄羅斯是沙烏地阿拉伯的固定小麥供應國之一。
paras_en: Several foreign media outlets reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin said that Russia and Ukraine still have a chance to reach a peace agreement, easing market fears of a halt to Black Sea grain exports; Chicago Board of Trade wheat futures fell more than 2% on Thursday (March 3), retreating from the multi‑year high reached earlier this week.

Over the past month, market concerns that Russia‑Ukraine Black Sea grain exports could be disrupted drove wheat prices sharply higher. After Putin signaled peace, some traders took profits, which was the main reason for the day's decline in wheat futures.

On Thursday at an economic forum in Russia's Far East, Putin said that the United States, China and other countries were willing to help push the peace process forward and that a deal between Russia and Ukraine was indeed possible, but he emphasized that the conflict ultimately must be resolved jointly by Russia and Ukraine.

On the same day, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the U.S. negotiating team had set a preliminary date for visits to Russia and Ukraine, with trips to Moscow and Kyiv planned in the coming days. He said the U.S. remains actively involved in mediation and is crucial to advancing the peace process.

U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Trump’s son‑in‑law, went to Moscow in January but have yet to visit Kyiv. The last time Russia and Ukraine participated in U.S.‑mediated talks was in February of this year.

When President Trump was interviewed by GB News in the United Kingdom, he said he hoped the war and casualties would end and that he believed the goal could ultimately be achieved. Trump said the day before that he would hold a summit with Putin if Putin was ready to talk peace.

Despite the rare positive signals from both sides, some wheat traders remain cautious, believing Putin’s remarks do not mean military action will decrease and that actual disruptions to Black Sea grain transport have not changed.

Putin accused Ukraine of attacking civilian merchant ships and of Kyiv demanding that civilian aircraft avoid Russian airspace, making it harder to restart negotiations. He said Russia and Ukraine still maintain contact, mainly through intelligence channels, but it is unclear whether these contacts can lead to a peace agreement at this stage.
As both sides increased long‑range airstrikes, attacks on ports and merchant ships have clearly escalated.
The Ukrainian Grain Association (UGA) announced on Thursday that Ukraine’s August grain and oilseed exports fell from 2.5 million tonnes in July to 1.2 million tonnes.
Markets are also watching Saudi Arabia’s wheat import tender announced on Thursday and the responses from suppliers. Russia is one of Saudi Arabia’s fixed wheat suppliers.

items.title: 〈財報〉Lululemon下修全年財測！轉型陣痛加劇 盤後股價慘摔18%
paras: Lululemon(LULU-US)再度交出不如市場預期的財報，並下修全年財測，周四(3日)盤後股價暴跌18%，凸顯這家運動服飾大廠正陷入一場爭取投資人與消費者認同的苦戰，也顯示新任執行長即將上任之際，公司面臨的挑戰更加嚴峻。

財測關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估

Q3

營收：22.9-23.2億美元
EPS：93-98美分


全年

營收：103.5-105億美元 vs 億美元

Lululemon預估，第3季營收將介於22.9-23.2億美元，較去年同期下滑約10%至11%，EPS估介於0.93-0.98美元。
全年方面，Lululemon預估淨營收介於103.5-105億美元，較去年下滑5-7%，也低於先前預估的110-111.5億美元。全年EPS介於9.48-9.73美元，低於先前預估的10.95-11.15美元。Lululemon並表示，最新展望已計入關稅退款帶來的提振效果。
代理共同執行長兼財務長Meghan Frank在財報聲明中表示：「儘管我們持續因應一些充滿挑戰的動態變化，但在修正全年展望時，我們採取了審慎的態度。」
Lululemon股價今年以來共下跌41%。該股周四稍早收高1.42%至每股121.77美元，財報公布後，盤後股價應聲跳水，截稿前跌18.2%。

Q2財報(8月2日止)關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估


營收：24.2億美元 vs 24.6億美元
EPS：2.92美元 vs 1.79美元
同店銷售：年減9% vs 年減4.6%


Lululemon上季營收年減4%至24.2億美元，同店銷售額下滑9%，EPS則為2.92美元。
Lululemon公布財報與展望之際，分析師正等待新任執行長Heidi O"Neill到任，她曾在Nike與Levi"s任職，將於9月8日接掌公司。
Lululemon近期面臨產品品質與時尚吸引力下滑的疑慮，也與創辦人Chip Wilson爆發董事會紛爭。同時，消費者轉趨謹慎，以及Alo與Vuori等競爭對手帶來的壓力，也拖累Lululemon股價。
分析師近來質疑Lululemon的時尚選擇，並批評該公司偏離原本的核心運動服飾定位，包括近年擴大產品線，推出橄欖球衫、吊飾等商品，以及與Disney(DIS-US)等品牌合作。
代理執行長Frank在周四的電話會議上表示，管理團隊目前聚焦推出新款產品及更嚴格控管庫存，希望重返營收成長軌道。
Frank說：「我們知道還有許多工作要做。管理團隊領導階層與全體員工正專注服務消費者，並執行各項措施，推動公司業務出現轉折。」
Jefferies分析師Randal Konik表示，Lululemon除了必須淘汰「雜亂無章」的配色與過度使用Logo的設計外，也需要改善企業文化。他認為，明年可能將是市場觀察「新執行長改革何時開始開花結果」的一年。

paras_en: 9/4 Taiwan Stock Market Pre‑Market News

1. On the 3rd, the Taiwan index fell 307 points, breaking the 46,000 barrier. Foreign investors sold another NT$48.1 billion, a total of NT$139.5 billion over two days, while the Taiwan Index Futures covered 3,704 short contracts, reducing net shorts to 81,500 contracts, showing a divergence between futures and spot. In equities, foreign investors heavily sold memory‑chip stocks but bought the two panel giants and shipping stocks. In the futures night session, the index rebounded over 600 points, briefly reaching 46,559 points, first to retake the 46,000 level.

2. Power‑supply maker Lite‑On Technology (2301‑TW) announced on the 3rd a strategic investment in Polish liquid‑cooling solution company DCX POLSKA Sp. z o.o. (referred to as “DCX Liquid Cooling Systems”). DCX focuses on advanced liquid‑cooling systems for AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) data centers, offering a full product portfolio and deep technical expertise. After the deal, Lite‑On will hold about 25% of DCX, with a transaction value of roughly US$176 million (approximately NT$5.588 billion).

3. Wei‑Ying (6669‑TW) Chairman Hong Li‑ning attended FinTechOn 2026 on the 3rd and, in her remarks, emphasized that financial technology must be integrated into the global supply chain, becoming an indispensable part, and highlighted speed, transparency and trust as the three core keys.

4. Taiwan Fertilizer celebrated its 80th anniversary on the 3rd with President Lai Ching‑de and Agriculture Minister Chen Jun‑ji attending. Over eight decades, the company has evolved from a pillar of national grain stability and farmer support to revitalizing its Nangang assets and transforming into a high‑tech supply chain. Minister Chen pointed out that Taiwan Fertilizer’s recently certified “blue ammonia” has successfully entered the semiconductor supply chain. Regarding its core fertilizer business, spokesperson Zhong Jun‑ming said that with low‑priced inventory, increased government subsidies and stable raw‑material prices, this year’s loss is expected to shrink dramatically, aiming to cut NT$500 million and continue toward sustainability and new technology avenues.

5. OTC leader Han‑Ce (7856‑TW) is preparing a public offering ahead of its upcoming OTC‑to‑OTC upgrade. It will auction 4,192 shares at a floor price of NT$1,800, with a maximum of 524 shares per bidder, and a provisional underwriting price of NT$2,250 per share. The auction runs from Sep 7‑9, with the opening bid on Sep 11; a public subscription period is Sep 10‑14, lottery on Sep 16, and listing planned for late September. Based on the closing price of NT$4,520 on the 3rd, each winning share would yield a 100% return, an astonishing potential profit.

6. Semiconductor equipment maker Fan‑Xuan (6196‑TW) held a 20‑year anniversary event with partner Mennens on the 3rd. items.title: 輝達把Blackwell塞進電腦！聯想、宏碁10月首發RTX Spark
items.title_en: Nvidia Packs Blackwell into PCs! Lenovo, Acer to Launch RTX Spark in October
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周四(3日)宣布，聯想集團(00992-HK)與宏碁(2353-TW)將於10月推出首批搭載RTX Spark晶片的Windows個人電腦，進一步將人工智慧(AI)運算能力從雲端帶進筆電與桌上型電腦。
隨著AI服務快速普及，科技業者日益重視裝置端AI，希望直接在使用者的電腦上處理任務，藉此降低雲端運算成本，同時改善資料隱私、回應速度及離線使用能力。
輝達表示，宏碁與聯想將加入採用RTX Spark的平台業者行列。這款晶片整合輝達Blackwell繪圖處理器(GPU)與Grace中央處理器(CPU)，讓個人電腦可在本機執行更複雜的生成式AI模型及相關工作負載。
輝達今年6月發表RTX Spark，是與微軟(MSFT-US)合作3年的成果之一。雙方希望為AI時代「重新發明個人電腦」，讓Windows PC不再只是連接雲端AI服務的終端裝置，而能直接在本機進行模型推論、內容生成及AI代理人運算。
RTX Spark的開發也有台灣晶片設計大廠聯發科(2454-TW)參與，顯示輝達在推動AI PC生態系時，正結合自身GPU、Grace CPU架構與聯發科的晶片設計能力。
裝置端AI也成為各大科技公司的競爭焦點。蘋果(AAPL-US)上月以最新M系列晶片更新Mac mini與Mac Studio，並強調新機能在本機執行更大型的AI模型及自主AI代理人。聯想與宏碁10月推出RTX Spark電腦後，Windows與Mac兩大陣營在裝置端AI市場的競爭可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Thursday (the 3rd) that Lenovo Group (00992-HK) and Acer (2353-TW) will launch the first batch of Windows personal computers equipped with RTX Spark chips in October, further bringing artificial intelligence (AI) computing power from the cloud to laptops and desktops.

As AI services spread rapidly, technology companies are increasingly focusing on device‑side AI, aiming to process tasks directly on users' computers to reduce cloud computing costs while improving data privacy, response speed, and offline capability.

Nvidia said Acer and Lenovo will join the ranks of platform vendors adopting RTX Spark. The chip integrates Nvidia's Blackwell graphics processing unit (GPU) with the Grace central processing unit (CPU), enabling personal computers to run more complex generative AI models and related workloads locally.

Nvidia unveiled RTX Spark in June this year, one of the outcomes of a three‑year collaboration with Microsoft (MSFT-US). The two aim to “re‑invent the personal computer” for the AI era, allowing Windows PCs to go beyond being mere endpoints for cloud AI services and to perform model inference, content generation, and AI agent computation on‑device.

The development of RTX Spark also involved Taiwan's major chip designer MediaTek (2454-TW), showing that Nvidia is combining its GPU and Grace CPU architectures with MediaTek's chip design expertise as it builds an AI PC ecosystem.

Device‑side AI has become a competitive focus for major tech firms. Apple (AAPL-US) last month refreshed the Mac mini and Mac Studio with its latest M‑series chips, emphasizing new capabilities for running larger AI models and autonomous AI agents on‑device. After Lenovo and Acer launch RTX Spark PCs in October, competition between the Windows and Mac camps in the device‑side AI market is expected to heat up further.

items.title: 上詮斥資15.38億擴產FAU生產線 Q3起依客戶需求交貨3.2T產品
items.title_en: Shang Chuan Allocates NT$1.538 Billion to Expand FAU Production Line, Delivering 3.2T Products from Q3 Based on Customer Demand
paras: 光通訊廠上詮(3363-TW)明(4)日將參加法人舉辦之2026第3季投資論壇，上詮為了強化CPO產品量產布局，持續建置FAU(光纖陣列單元)高精密自動化生產線，據上詮公開資訊顯示，公司於今(2026)年至明(2027)年第2季起規劃投入資本支出約15.38億元建置產線，FAU生產機台約占其中的10.8億元。
上詮看準光通訊市場需求，早在近年來持續深耕光通訊的矽光專利多項技術認證，據公開資訊指出，去(2025)年第4季上詮已啟動無塵室及CPO FAU高精密自動化生產線建置，今(2026)年2月再完成31.6億元現金增資，持續擴充產能以提供客戶出貨。
據上詮FAU量產規劃，公司於今年至2027年第2季資本支出費用共15.38億元，主要著重在FAU生產機台以及光檢、量測或其他測試機台上的資本支出費用，顯示近1年多來，公司持續積極擴充、擴大產線。
展望未來布局，上詮也將規劃依客戶需求進一步交付3.2T及6.4T以上FAU產敏，預計在今年第3季交付客戶要求貨量為3.2T FAU，2027年之後交付3.2T、6.4T的FAU產品。
法人指出，上詮隨著AI資料中心高速光通訊架構持續升級下，公司持續擴充自動化產能與測試設備，將為後續的CPO需求出量先做產線準備。
paras_en: Optical communications manufacturer Shang Chuan (3363‑TW) will attend the legal‑entity‑hosted 2026 Q3 Investment Forum tomorrow (April 4). To strengthen its mass‑production layout for CPO products, Shang Chuan is continuing to build a high‑precision automated FAU (Fiber Array Unit) production line. According to publicly disclosed information, the company plans to invest about NT$1.538 billion in capital expenditures from this year (2026) through the second quarter of 2027 to construct the line, with roughly NT$1.08 billion earmarked for FAU production equipment.

Shang Chuan has identified strong demand in the optical communications market and, in recent years, has been deepening its silicon‑photonic patent portfolio with multiple technology certifications. Public data shows that in Q4 2025 the company launched a clean‑room and a high‑precision automated CPO FAU production line, and in February 2026 completed a cash increase of NT$3.16 billion to further expand capacity for customer shipments.

According to Shang Chuan’s FAU mass‑production plan, the total capital spending from this year through Q2 2027 will be NT$1.538 billion, primarily focused on FAU production machines as well as optical inspection, measurement and other testing equipment, indicating that over the past year the company has been actively expanding and scaling its production lines.

Looking ahead, Shang Chuan plans to deliver FAU products of 3.2 T and above 6.4 T based on customer demand. It expects to ship 3.2 T FAU units to customers in Q3 2026, with deliveries of 3.2 T and 6.4 T FAU products slated for after 2027.

Legal entities note that as AI data‑center high‑speed optical communication architectures continue to upgrade, Shang Chuan is continuously expanding its automated production capacity and testing equipment, preparing the production line in advance to meet future CPO demand.

items.title: SpaceX市值重返2兆美元大關！AI基礎設施強勢發威 專家讚上漲空間50%
items.title_en: SpaceX's Market Value Returns to the $2 Trillion Mark! AI Infrastructure Shows Strong Momentum, Experts Praise 50% Upside Potential
paras: 睽違兩個月，SpaceX市值終於重返2兆美元，顯示這檔股票在公開市場經歷初期劇烈波動後，已重新獲得投資人青睞。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(3日)上漲6.4%至每股149.74美元，盤中一度突破150美元，為7月10日以來首見。以收盤價計算，SpaceX市值略高於2兆美元，是自7月6日以來首次重返2兆美元。
目前美國僅少數企業市值超過2兆美元，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)。
SpaceX股價反彈之際，分析師持續看好其上漲潛力，而美國股市整體走強，也為股價提供支撐。根據FactSet數據，SpaceX平均目標價為225.87美元，與目前股價相比仍有約50%的上漲空間。
近來也有多名分析師重申對SpaceX的正面評等，例如Oppenheimer分析師Timothy Horan認為，在目前人工智慧(AI)資源供應短缺的環境下，SpaceX將成為主要受惠者。他也表示，隨著SpaceX開發功能更強大的AI模型，相關AI營收的成長速度快於市場預期。
Horan周三維持SpaceX「買進」評等，並表示，SpaceX「有能力比任何人更快建置基礎設施，並利用這些基礎設施及數據，以比任何人更快的速度改善自身模型」。

特斯拉同步大漲 Cybercab將整合Starlink

同在馬斯克麾下的特斯拉(TSLA-US)，周四也勁揚5.4%，投資人正準備迎接Cybercab自駕計程車發表活動。
由於兩家公司關係密切，SpaceX可能也會在周四的活動中扮演角色。馬斯克今年7月曾向投資人表示，SpaceX旗下衛星網路服務星鏈(Starlink)將整合至Cybercab。
他表示，這將有助於特斯拉避免車輛失去連線，否則可能出現「無法追蹤、失去聯繫的自駕計程車」。這項連線功能也可用於娛樂用途。
馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示：「如果人們坐在車裡，他們可能想做一些高效率的事情，或是想要娛樂。有了Starlink，你可以在車內觀看4K高畫質直播體育賽事。」
輝達(NVDA-US)在內的大型科技股周四也走高，並帶動Roundhill「科技七巨頭」ETF(MAGS-US)逼近歷史收盤高點。根據道瓊市場數據，該ETF終場距離5月14日創下的70.94美元歷史收盤高點不到1個百分點。
paras_en: After a two‑month hiatus, SpaceX's market value finally returned to $2 trillion, indicating that the stock, after experiencing sharp early‑stage volatility in the public market, has regained investors' favor.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) shares rose 6.4% on Thursday the 3rd to $149.74 per share, briefly breaking the $150 level intraday for the first time since July 10. At the close, SpaceX’s market cap was just above $2 trillion, marking the first return to that level since July 6.
Only a handful of U.S. companies now have market caps above $2 trillion, including Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US).

As SpaceX’s stock rebounds, analysts remain bullish on its upside, and the overall strength of the U.S. equity market also supports the price. FactSet data shows an average target price of $225.87 for SpaceX, implying roughly a 50% upside from the current price.

Several analysts have recently reiterated positive ratings on SpaceX. Oppenheimer analyst Timothy Horan believes that, amid the current shortage of AI resources, SpaceX will be a primary beneficiary. He also notes that as SpaceX develops more powerful AI models, its AI‑related revenue growth is outpacing market expectations.

Horan maintained a “Buy” rating on SpaceX on Wednesday, stating that SpaceX “has the ability to build infrastructure faster than anyone and to use that infrastructure and data to improve its models at a speed no one else can match.”
Tesla (TSLA‑US), also led by Musk, surged 5.4% on Thursday as investors gear up for the Cybercab autonomous‑taxi launch event.

Because the two companies are closely linked, SpaceX may also play a role in Thursday’s event. In July, Musk told investors that SpaceX’s satellite‑internet service Starlink would be integrated into Cybercab.

He said this would help Tesla avoid losing connectivity in its vehicles, which could otherwise result in “untrackable, disconnected autonomous taxis.” The connectivity feature could also be used for entertainment purposes.

Musk said during the earnings call, “If people are sitting in the car, they might want to do something productive or be entertained. With Starlink, you can watch 4K high‑definition live sports inside the vehicle.”

Large‑cap tech stocks, including Nvidia (NVDA‑US), rose on Thursday, pulling the Roundhill “Tech Seven Giants” ETF (MAGS‑US) close to its historical closing high. According to Dow Jones market data, the ETF finished less than one percent away from its May 14 record high of $70.94.

items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab to make its first public debut in China
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 3日（周四）宣布，賽博無人駕駛電動車Cybercab正式在美國奧斯汀投入營運。

items.title: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok一度集體當機 持續近4小時
items.title_en: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Simultaneously Went Offline for Nearly Four Hours
paras: 本次三大AI模型當機時間持續約3小時40分，截至台灣時間4日（周五）凌晨1點10分，所有服務已經恢復，Gemini在這次事件中從未通報服務中斷。
此前，Downdetector上用戶通報以及各公司狀態頁面顯示，多家AI公司的服務中斷。
Anthropic表示，正在調查Claude出現的錯誤，並致力於修復。OpenAI說，ChatGPT和Codex出現問題。SpaceXAI稱，Grok出現故障，正在調查服務中斷。
Downdetector的數據顯示，超過12,000份用戶通報指出OpenAI有問題。關於Claude的問題通報約1,200份。Grok的問題通報約1,000份。
雖然AI服務當機不算罕見，但三家巨頭平台同時出現故障並不尋常。
目前來看，Gemini未受影響。儘管在同一時間段內用戶通報數量有所上升，但Google尚未確認服務中斷。
底層原因可能與微軟(MSFT-US) Azure有關，該平台同樣出現了故障通報激增的情況。這三家AI平台均依賴Azure提供雲端運算服務，不過它們的算力架構中也包含了Google等其他服務商。
paras_en: The three major AI models were down for about 3 hours and 40 minutes; by 1:10 a.m. Taiwan time on the 4th (Friday), all services had been restored, and Gemini did not report any service interruption during this incident.
Previously, user reports on Downdetector and status pages from various companies indicated that several AI services were disrupted.
Anthropic said it was investigating an error with Claude and working to fix it. OpenAI reported issues with ChatGPT and Codex. SpaceXAI stated that Grok had a fault and was investigating the outage.
Downdetector data showed over 12,000 user reports indicating problems with OpenAI. About 1,200 reports concerned Claude, and roughly 1,000 reports were about Grok.
While AI service outages are not uncommon, it is unusual for three major platforms to fail simultaneously.
Gemini appears to have been unaffected. Although the number of user reports increased during the same period, Google has not confirmed a service interruption.

The underlying cause may be related to Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure, which also saw a surge in outage reports. All three AI platforms rely on Azure for cloud computing, though their compute architectures also include other providers such as Google.

items.title: 【美股盤後】科技股領漲，那斯達克連二紅；市場聚焦聯準會政策與非農就業
items.title_en: US Stocks After Hours: Tech Leads Gains, Nasdaq Posts Second Straight Rise; Market Focuses on Fed Policy and Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國股市周四全面收高，科技股成為主要推力，那斯達克指數上漲1.4%，連續第二個交易日走揚；標普500指數上漲1.1%，道瓊工業指數上漲1.2%、漲逾600點，小型股羅素2000指數則上漲0.5%。
市場情緒改善主要受到聯準會理事Christopher Waller談話帶動。Waller表示，如果接下來通膨數據持續朝聯準會2%目標改善，他願意支持9月會議維持政策利率不變。美國10年期公債殖利率因此下跌3個基點至4.76%，為成長股提供支撐。
大型科技股普遍走高，微軟Microsoft(MSFT-US)與高盛Goldman Sachs(GS-US)均上漲逾3%，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)及輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)均上漲逾1%。特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)則在Cybercab活動登場前大漲近7%。
個股方面，Snowflake(SNOW-US)財報優於預期後大漲逾23%，第2季每股盈餘0.62元、年增率77%，營收16億美元、年增率35%，雙雙超越市場預期。相較之下，Ciena(CIEN-US)即使財報優於預期，仍因供應限制及利潤率展望疑慮大跌近11%，凸顯AI概念股開始出現明顯分化。
經濟數據方面，美國8月服務業維持擴張，ISM服務業指數為55.4，高於市場預估54.1；初領失業救濟金人數則增至20.6萬人。市場下一個焦點轉向周五公布的8月非農就業報告，市場預估新增5.5萬個就業機會，失業率則可能由4.1%升至4.2%。

paras_en: On Thursday, U.S. equities closed higher across the board, with technology stocks providing the main thrust. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.4%, marking a second consecutive session of gains; the S&P 500 climbed 1.1%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 1.2%—up more than 600 points—and the small‑cap Russell 2000 added 0.5%.

The improvement in market sentiment was largely driven by comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller. Waller said that if inflation data continue to move toward the Fed’s 2% target, he would be willing to support keeping the policy rate unchanged at the September meeting. U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields fell three basis points to 4.76%, providing support for growth stocks.

Large‑cap tech stocks broadly rose, with Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) each gaining more than 3%. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) all climbed over 1%. Tesla (TSLA‑US) surged nearly 7% ahead of its Cybercab event.

On the individual stock front, Snowflake (SNOW‑US) jumped more than 23% after reporting earnings that beat expectations—Q2 earnings per share of $0.62, up 77% year‑over‑year, and revenue of $1.6 billion, up 35%—both surpassing market forecasts. By contrast, Ciena (CIEN‑US) fell nearly 11% despite beating estimates, due to concerns over supply constraints and profit‑margin outlook, highlighting an emerging split among AI‑related stocks.

Regarding economic data, U.S. services activity remained in expansion in August, with the ISM Services Index at 55.4, above the market’s 54.1 forecast, while initial jobless claims rose to 206,000. The market’s next focus shifts to Friday’s August non‑farm payroll report, with expectations of 55,000 new jobs and the unemployment rate possibly edging up from 4.1% to 4.2%.

items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab Hits the Road, Stock Rises 5.4%, Market Focus Shifts to Robotaxi Scaling
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)周四正式在德州奧斯汀部分區域推出Cybercab載客服務，這款專為Robotaxi打造的雙人座車款沒有方向盤與踏板，首次加入特斯拉實際營運車隊，成為公司從電動車製造商轉向AI與自駕服務商的重要進展。市場提前反映期待，特斯拉股價周四上漲5.4%，盤後則變動不大。
Cybercab已於2026年4月開始生產，特斯拉並自6月進行道路測試。根據德州最新紀錄，特斯拉在當地登記的自駕車已達420輛，其中45輛為Cybercab；相較之下，目前美國Robotaxi市場領先者Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Waymo在德州共有988輛登記車輛，特斯拉車隊規模仍有一段差距。
不過，Cybercab此次正式載客的意義，在於特斯拉開始驗證「無方向盤、無踏板」Robotaxi能否真正投入商業營運。特斯拉目前並未說明Cybercab是否開始收費，也未透露所有Robotaxi App用戶能否叫到Cybercab，因此現階段仍屬限定區域的小規模營運。
市場接下來關注焦點也將從產品展示轉向實際營運能力，包括Cybercab是否能完全不配置安全監控人員、實際道路行駛需要多少遠端人工協助，以及車隊能多快從目前45輛擴大。
法規則是規模化的另一項限制。美國聯邦規定限制車廠銷售沒有方向盤與踏板的車輛數量，雖然測試用途可以部署更多車輛，但可能限制收費營運速度；在重要市場加州，特斯拉目前也尚未取得無安全駕駛員Robotaxi營運許可。
此外，特斯拉Robotaxi過去的擴張速度曾低於馬斯克原先目標。先前在達拉斯與休士頓的實際服務也曾出現等待時間過長、無車可叫，以及無法將乘客送至指定目的地等情況，顯示從自駕技術展示走向大規模穩定營運仍有挑戰。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Tesla (TSLA-US) officially launched its Cybercab passenger service on Thursday in parts of Austin, Texas. The two‑seat vehicle, built specifically for robotaxi use, has no steering wheel or pedals and is the first Tesla model to join an actual operating fleet, marking a key step in the company’s transition from an electric‑vehicle manufacturer to an AI and autonomous‑driving service provider. Anticipation was priced in early, with Tesla’s share price up 5.4% on Thursday and moving little after hours.

Cybercab production began in April 2026, and Tesla started road testing in June. According to the latest Texas records, Tesla has 420 registered autonomous vehicles in the state, of which 45 are Cybercabs. By contrast, Waymo, Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) robotaxi leader, has 988 registered vehicles in Texas, so Tesla’s fleet size still lags behind.

The significance of Cybercab’s first passenger rides lies in Tesla beginning to validate whether a “no‑steering‑wheel, no‑pedal” robotaxi can truly operate commercially. Tesla has not said whether the Cybercab rides are being charged, nor disclosed whether all robotaxi app users can summon a Cybercab, so the operation remains a small‑scale, limited‑area pilot at this stage.

Going forward, market attention will shift from product showcase to operational capability, including whether Cybercabs can run without any safety‑monitoring personnel, how much remote human assistance is needed for real‑world driving, and how quickly the fleet can grow beyond the current 45 units.

Regulation is another scaling constraint. U.S. federal rules limit the number of vehicles sold without steering wheels and pedals; while more units can be deployed for testing, this may curb the speed of paid operations. In the key market of California, Tesla has yet to obtain a permit to run robotaxis without a safety driver.

Moreover, Tesla’s robotaxi rollout has previously lagged behind Elon Musk’s original targets. Earlier services in Dallas and Houston suffered from long wait times, no cars available, and inability to drop passengers at their intended destinations, highlighting the challenges of moving from autonomous‑tech demos to large‑scale, reliable operations.

items.title: 普丁稱俄烏仍有望達成協議 芝加哥小麥期貨急跌超2%
items.title_en: Putin Says Russia‑Ukraine Still Has Chance to Reach Agreement, Chicago Wheat Futures Plunge Over 2%
paras: 多家外媒報導，俄羅斯總統普丁透露，俄烏兩國仍有機會達成和平協議，市場對黑海穀物出口中斷的擔憂隨之降溫，芝加哥期貨交易所小麥期貨週四 (3 日) 下跌逾 2%，從本週稍早觸及的多年高點回落。
過去一個月，市場擔憂俄羅斯與烏克蘭的黑海穀物出口可能受阻，帶動小麥價格大幅上漲。普丁釋出和平訊號後，部分交易員選擇獲利了結，成為當日小麥期貨下跌的主要原因。
普丁週四在俄羅斯遠東地區舉行的經濟論壇上表示，美國、中國等國都願意協助推動和平進程，俄烏確實存在達成協議的可能性。不過，他強調，這場衝突最終仍須由俄羅斯與烏克蘭共同解決。
同日，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基透露，美國談判代表訪問俄烏兩國的初步日期已經敲定，預計未來幾天分別前往莫斯科與基輔。他表示，美國持續積極參與斡旋，對推動和平進程十分重要。
負責促成俄烏協議的美國特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與川普女婿庫許納 (Jared Kushner)，今年 1 月曾前往莫斯科，但迄今尚未訪問基輔。俄烏雙方上一次參加由美國居中協調的談判是在今年 2 月。
美國總統川普接受英國《GB News》訪問時也表示，他希望俄烏戰爭及雙方傷亡能夠結束，並相信最終可以實現這項目標。川普前一天曾表示，只要普丁準備好談和平，他願意與其舉行峰會。
儘管俄烏雙方罕見對和平前景釋出正面訊號，部分小麥交易員仍保持謹慎，認為普丁的談話並不代表軍事行動即將減少，黑海穀物運輸面臨的實際干擾也沒有改變。
普丁指控，烏克蘭攻擊民用商船，以及基輔要求民航客機避開俄羅斯領空，正使重啟談判變得更加困難。他表示，俄烏目前仍維持接觸，主要透過情報管道進行，但現階段難以判斷這些接觸能否促成和平協議。
隨著雙方加強長程空襲，針對港口與商船的攻擊也明顯升級。
烏克蘭穀物交易商聯盟 (UGA) 週四公布，烏克蘭8月穀物與油籽出口量由7月的250萬公噸降至120萬公噸。
市場目前也在關注沙烏地阿拉伯週四公布的小麥進口招標，以及各國供應商的回應。俄羅斯是沙烏地阿拉伯的固定小麥供應國之一。
paras_en: Several foreign media outlets reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin said that Russia and Ukraine still have a chance to reach a peace agreement, easing market fears of a halt to Black Sea grain exports; Chicago Board of Trade wheat futures fell more than 2% on Thursday (March 3), retreating from the multi‑year high reached earlier this week.

Over the past month, market concerns that Russia‑Ukraine Black Sea grain exports could be disrupted drove wheat prices sharply higher. After Putin signaled peace, some traders took profits, which was the main reason for the day's decline in wheat futures.

On Thursday at an economic forum in Russia's Far East, Putin said that the United States, China and other countries were willing to help push the peace process forward and that a deal between Russia and Ukraine was indeed possible, but he emphasized that the conflict ultimately must be resolved jointly by Russia and Ukraine.

On the same day, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the U.S. negotiating team had set a preliminary date for visits to Russia and Ukraine, with trips to Moscow and Kyiv planned in the coming days. He said the U.S. remains actively involved in mediation and is crucial to advancing the peace process.

U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Trump’s son‑in‑law, went to Moscow in January but have yet to visit Kyiv. The last time Russia and Ukraine participated in U.S.‑mediated talks was in February of this year.

When President Trump was interviewed by GB News in the United Kingdom, he said he hoped the war and casualties would end and that he believed the goal could ultimately be achieved. Trump said the day before that he would hold a summit with Putin if Putin was ready to talk peace.

Despite the rare positive signals from both sides, some wheat traders remain cautious, believing Putin’s remarks do not mean military action will decrease and that actual disruptions to Black Sea grain transport have not changed.

Putin accused Ukraine of attacking civilian merchant ships and of Kyiv demanding that civilian aircraft avoid Russian airspace, making it harder to restart negotiations. He said Russia and Ukraine still maintain contact, mainly through intelligence channels, but it is unclear whether these contacts can lead to a peace agreement at this stage.
As both sides increased long‑range airstrikes, attacks on ports and merchant ships have clearly escalated.
The Ukrainian Grain Association (UGA) announced on Thursday that Ukraine’s August grain and oilseed exports fell from 2.5 million tonnes in July to 1.2 million tonnes.
Markets are also watching Saudi Arabia’s wheat import tender announced on Thursday and the responses from suppliers. Russia is one of Saudi Arabia’s fixed wheat suppliers.

items.title: 〈財報〉Lululemon下修全年財測！轉型陣痛加劇 盤後股價慘摔18%
paras: Lululemon(LULU-US)再度交出不如市場預期的財報，並下修全年財測，周四(3日)盤後股價暴跌18%，凸顯這家運動服飾大廠正陷入一場爭取投資人與消費者認同的苦戰，也顯示新任執行長即將上任之際，公司面臨的挑戰更加嚴峻。

財測關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估

Q3

營收：22.9-23.2億美元
EPS：93-98美分


全年

營收：103.5-105億美元 vs 億美元
EPS：9.48-9.73美元 vs 美元


Lululemon預估，第3季營收將介於22.9-23.2億美元，較去年同期下滑約10%至11%，EPS估介於0.93-0.98美元。
全年方面，Lululemon預估淨營收介於103.5-105億美元，較去年下滑5-7%，也低於先前預估的110-111.5億美元。全年EPS介於9.48-9.73美元，低於先前預估的10.95-11.15美元。Lululemon並表示，最新展望已計入關稅退款帶來的提振效果。
代理共同執行長兼財務長Meghan Frank在財報聲明中表示：「儘管我們持續因應一些充滿挑戰的動態變化，但在修正全年展望時，我們採取了審慎的態度。」
Lululemon股價今年以來共下跌41%。該股周四稍早收高1.42%至每股121.77美元，財報公布後，盤後股價應聲跳水，截稿前跌18.2%。

Q2財報(8月2日止)關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估


營收：24.2億美元 vs 24.6億美元
EPS：2.92美元 vs 1.79美元
同店銷售：年減9% vs 年減4.6%


Lululemon上季營收年減4%至24.2億美元，同店銷售額下滑9%，EPS則為2.92美元。
Lululemon公布財報與展望之際，分析師正等待新任執行長Heidi O"Neill到任，她曾在Nike與Levi"s任職，將於9月8日接掌公司。
Lululemon近期面臨產品品質與時尚吸引力下滑的疑慮，也與創辦人Chip Wilson爆發董事會紛爭。同時，消費者轉趨謹慎，以及Alo與Vuori等競爭對手帶來的壓力，也拖累Lululemon股價。
分析師近來質疑Lululemon的時尚選擇，並批評該公司偏離原本的核心運動服飾定位，包括近年擴大產品線，推出橄欖球衫、吊飾等商品，以及與Disney(DIS-US)等品牌合作。
代理執行長Frank在周四的電話會議上表示，管理團隊目前聚焦推出新款產品及更嚴格控管庫存，希望重返營收成長軌道。
Frank說：「我們知道還有許多工作要做。管理團隊領導階層與全體員工正專注服務消費者，並執行各項措施，推動公司業務出現轉折。」
Jefferies分析師Randal Konik表示，Lululemon除了必須淘汰「雜亂無章」的配色與過度使用Logo的設計外，也需要改善企業文化。他認為，明年可能將是市場觀察「新執行長改革何時開始開花結果」的一年。

paras: 美國副總統范斯週四(3日)表示，聯準會(Fed)應下調利率來減輕民眾的購屋壓力，此舉進一步強化白宮向Fed施壓、要求降低借貸成本的力度。
范斯在白宮記者會上發表上述言論之際，正值美國總統川普親自挑選的Fed主席華許恐將反其道而行。
當被問及川普政府對近期美國債市波動的看法時，范斯說：「顯然，總統非常關注利率問題。他之所以如此關注，主要原因之一是希望美國民眾能買得起房。利率一旦走高，借貸成本也會隨之上升。」
范斯還說，「我們認為Fed理應降息」，並稱這是應對近期美國通膨數據的「合理且負責任」的做法。
他並表示，川普政府正採取多項措施試圖壓低利率，但如果Fed能幫個忙，那就再好不過了。
范斯發言恐加劇外界對Fed在川普治下獨立性受損的擔憂。此前，川普曾極力施壓Fed前主席鮑爾大幅降息，目前仍在試圖解僱聯準會理事庫克。
華許上周五(8月28日)在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會上表示，他致力於將通膨率降至聯準會2%的目標水平，並認為利率是實現這一目標的關鍵工具。這番言論被視為鷹派發言，令市場上升息預期升溫，升息機率重新佔上風。
Fed理事巴爾本周二(1日)也表示，若通膨持續居高不下，他已準備好支持升息。
然而，隨著更多重量級聯準會官員發表講話，Fed本月是否會升息，又出現了新的疑問。Fed理事華勒周四(3日)意外釋放強力鴿派訊號。華勒表示，若即將公佈的數據確認通膨壓力正在降溫，他傾向支持9月按兵不動。
根據芝加哥商品交易所(CME)FedWatch數據，交易員認為Fed在9月15日至16日會議上升息與按兵不動的機率幾乎五五開，本週稍早升息機率曾一度高達近70%。
隨著市場對升息預期再度回落，美債殖利率周四進一步回落，接下來投資人將密切關注周五(4日)公佈的非農就業報告，繼續尋找Fed未來利率路徑的線索。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President Farris said on Thursday (the 3rd) that the Federal Reserve should lower interest rates to ease the public’s housing‑buying pressure, further intensifying the White House’s push on the Fed to reduce borrowing costs.
Farris made the remarks at a White House press briefing just as President Trump‑chosen Fed Chair Whitaker appears poised to take the opposite approach.

When asked about the Trump administration’s view on recent volatility in the U.S. bond market, Farris said, “Obviously the President is very concerned about rates. One of the main reasons is that he wants Americans to be able to afford a home. When rates rise, borrowing costs rise as well.”
Farris added, “We believe the Fed ought to cut rates,” calling it a “reasonable and responsible” response to the latest U.S. inflation data.
He said the Trump administration is already taking multiple steps to try to push rates lower, and it would be even better if the Fed could lend a hand.

Farris’s comments could heighten concerns about the Fed’s independence under Trump. Previously, Trump heavily pressured former Fed Chair Powell to cut rates dramatically and is still attempting to fire Fed Governor Cook.

Whitaker told the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last Friday (Aug. 28) that he is committed to bringing inflation down to the Fed’s 2% target and sees interest rates as the key tool, a hawkish stance that has revived market expectations of rate hikes.
Fed Governor Barl said on Tuesday (the 1st) that if inflation remains stubbornly high, he is ready to support another rate increase.

However, as more senior Fed officials speak, new questions arise about whether the Fed will hike this month. Fed Governor Wheeler on Thursday (the 3rd) unexpectedly sent a strong dovish signal, saying that if upcoming data confirm inflation pressures are easing, he leans toward holding rates steady in September.

According to CME FedWatch data, traders see the odds of a rate hike versus a hold at the September 15‑16 meeting as roughly 50‑50, after the probability of a hike earlier this week briefly spiked to nearly 70%.

With market expectations for a hike receding, U.S. Treasury yields fell further on Thursday, and investors will now watch Friday’s (the 4th) non‑farm payroll report closely for clues on the Fed’s future rate path.

items.title: SpaceX市值重返2兆美元大關！AI基礎設施強勢發威 專家讚上漲空間50%
items.title_en: SpaceX's Market Value Returns to the $2 Trillion Mark! AI Infrastructure Shows Strong Momentum, Experts Praise 50% Upside Potential
paras: 睽違兩個月，SpaceX市值終於重返2兆美元，顯示這檔股票在公開市場經歷初期劇烈波動後，已重新獲得投資人青睞。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(3日)上漲6.4%至每股149.74美元，盤中一度突破150美元，為7月10日以來首見。以收盤價計算，SpaceX市值略高於2兆美元，是自7月6日以來首次重返2兆美元。
目前美國僅少數企業市值超過2兆美元，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)。
SpaceX股價反彈之際，分析師持續看好其上漲潛力，而美國股市整體走強，也為股價提供支撐。根據FactSet數據，SpaceX平均目標價為225.87美元，與目前股價相比仍有約50%的上漲空間。
近來也有多名分析師重申對SpaceX的正面評等，例如Oppenheimer分析師Timothy Horan認為，在目前人工智慧(AI)資源供應短缺的環境下，SpaceX將成為主要受惠者。他也表示，隨著SpaceX開發功能更強大的AI模型，相關AI營收的成長速度快於市場預期。
Horan周三維持SpaceX「買進」評等，並表示，SpaceX「有能力比任何人更快建置基礎設施，並利用這些基礎設施及數據，以比任何人更快的速度改善自身模型」。

特斯拉同步大漲 Cybercab將整合Starlink

同在馬斯克麾下的特斯拉(TSLA-US)，周四也勁揚5.4%，投資人正準備迎接Cybercab自駕計程車發表活動。
由於兩家公司關係密切，SpaceX可能也會在周四的活動中扮演角色。馬斯克今年7月曾向投資人表示，SpaceX旗下衛星網路服務星鏈(Starlink)將整合至Cybercab。
他表示，這將有助於特斯拉避免車輛失去連線，否則可能出現「無法追蹤、失去聯繫的自駕計程車」。這項連線功能也可用於娛樂用途。
馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示：「如果人們坐在車裡，他們可能想做一些高效率的事情，或是想要娛樂。有了Starlink，你可以在車內觀看4K高畫質直播體育賽事。」
輝達(NVDA-US)在內的大型科技股周四也走高，並帶動Roundhill「科技七巨頭」ETF(MAGS-US)逼近歷史收盤高點。根據道瓊市場數據，該ETF終場距離5月14日創下的70.94美元歷史收盤高點不到1個百分點。
paras_en: After a two‑month hiatus, SpaceX's market value finally returned to $2 trillion, indicating that the stock, after experiencing sharp early‑stage volatility in the public market, has regained investors' favor.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) shares rose 6.4% on Thursday the 3rd to $149.74 per share, briefly breaking the $150 level intraday for the first time since July 10. At the close, SpaceX’s market cap was just above $2 trillion, marking the first return to that level since July 6.
Only a handful of U.S. companies now have market caps above $2 trillion, including Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US).

As SpaceX’s stock rebounds, analysts remain bullish on its upside, and the overall strength of the U.S. equity market also supports the price. FactSet data shows an average target price of $225.87 for SpaceX, implying roughly a 50% upside from the current price.

Several analysts have recently reiterated positive ratings on SpaceX. Oppenheimer analyst Timothy Horan believes that, amid the current shortage of AI resources, SpaceX will be a primary beneficiary. He also notes that as SpaceX develops more powerful AI models, its AI‑related revenue growth is outpacing market expectations.

Horan maintained a “Buy” rating on SpaceX on Wednesday, stating that SpaceX “has the ability to build infrastructure faster than anyone and to use that infrastructure and data to improve its models at a speed no one else can match.”
Tesla (TSLA‑US), also led by Musk, surged 5.4% on Thursday as investors gear up for the Cybercab autonomous‑taxi launch event.

Because the two companies are closely linked, SpaceX may also play a role in Thursday’s event. In July, Musk told investors that SpaceX’s satellite‑internet service Starlink would be integrated into Cybercab.

He said this would help Tesla avoid losing connectivity in its vehicles, which could otherwise result in “untrackable, disconnected autonomous taxis.” The connectivity feature could also be used for entertainment purposes.

Musk said during the earnings call, “If people are sitting in the car, they might want to do something productive or be entertained. With Starlink, you can watch 4K high‑definition live sports inside the vehicle.”

Large‑cap tech stocks, including Nvidia (NVDA‑US), rose on Thursday, pulling the Roundhill “Tech Seven Giants” ETF (MAGS‑US) close to its historical closing high. According to Dow Jones market data, the ETF finished less than one percent away from its May 14 record high of $70.94.

items.title: 黃金上漲邏輯變了！市場不再只看通膨，而是開始擔心美國債務
items.title_en: Gold's Rise Driven by New Logic: Market Shifts Focus from Inflation to U.S. Debt
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 黃金8月再度走強，但推動金價上漲的市場邏輯正在改變。過去投資人買進黃金，多半是為了對抗通膨或市場風險，但近期資金開始把黃金視為政府債券之外的「替代性儲備資產」，市場關注焦點也逐漸轉向美國政府債務能否被市場順利消化。
金價在8月24日當周一度升至每盎司4,658美元，創逾3個月高點，之後回落至4,455美元。除了黃金ETF資金強勁流入、央行需求回升及美元走弱外，長天期公債遭到拋售，以及市場對政府融資可持續性的疑慮，也成為推升金價的重要因素。
尤其Jackson Hole全球央行年會之後，市場開始關注政府債務持續增加，是否可能進一步牽制央行政策。隨著公債發行規模擴大，投資人愈來愈在意市場能否順利消化新增供給。一旦承接意願下降並推升公債殖利率，不僅會增加政府融資成本，也可能壓縮聯準會的政策空間，進一步影響市場對貨幣政策的信心。
這也讓黃金與過去最大的不同，在於市場不再只是交易「通膨上升、黃金上漲」的傳統邏輯，而是開始交易「政府債務增加、債券吸收能力下降、資金尋找替代儲備資產」的新邏輯。
因此，後續觀察金價不能只看通膨與聯準會利率政策。美國公債發行與市場吸收狀況、長天期債券流動性、政府財政赤字，以及央行對黃金的配置需求，都可能成為影響下一階段金價的重要變數。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Gold rallied again in August, but the market logic behind the price increase is changing. Historically, investors bought gold mainly to hedge against inflation or market risk, but recently capital is treating gold as an “alternative reserve asset” beyond government bonds, and attention is shifting toward whether U.S. government debt can be smoothly absorbed by the market.

Gold prices peaked at $4,658 per ounce during the week of August 24 before retreating to $4,455. In addition to strong inflows into gold ETFs, rebounding central‑bank demand and a weaker dollar, the sell‑off of long‑term Treasuries and concerns about the sustainability of government financing have become key drivers of the price rise.

Especially after the Jackson Hole global central‑bank meeting, the market began to focus on the continual rise in government debt and whether it could further constrain central‑bank policy. As Treasury issuance expands, investors are increasingly worried about the market’s ability to absorb the new supply. A drop in demand would push yields higher, raising government financing costs and potentially narrowing the Federal Reserve’s policy space, which in turn could erode confidence in monetary policy.

This marks a major departure from the traditional view that “higher inflation leads to higher gold.” The market is now trading on a new logic: “rising government debt, reduced bond‑absorption capacity, and capital seeking alternative reserve assets.”

Consequently, future gold price analysis cannot rely solely on inflation and Fed rate policy. The scale of U.S. Treasury issuance and market absorption, long‑term bond liquidity, fiscal deficits, and central‑bank demand for gold could all become important variables shaping the next phase of gold prices.

items.title: 川普政府醞釀新一輪半導體關稅三星、SK海力士美國產能成防火牆
items.title_en: Trump Administration Mulls New Round of Semiconductor Tariffs; Samsung and SK Hynix U.S. Production Becomes a Firewall
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 川普政府正醞釀新一輪半導體關稅，政策方向逐漸從年初針對特定先進晶片的定向措施，擴大至更多半導體及搭載晶片的終端產品。對三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)與SK海力士SK Hynix(000660-KR)而言，值得注意的是，美國正考慮將關稅優惠與當地製造投資掛鉤，而兩家公司已提前布局美國產能，可望成為南韓政府與美方談判時，爭取關稅優惠、降低衝擊的重要籌碼。
美國商務部長Howard Lutnick日前表示，川普政府正在制定更具針對性且經過審慎考量的半導體關稅政策。政策核心逐漸浮現，在美國投資製造的企業有機會取得關稅優惠，沒有美國產能的業者則可能面臨較高進口成本。
相較2026年1月美國對特定先進運算晶片及部分衍生產品課徵25%關稅，新一階段討論範圍可能更廣，包括筆記型電腦、遊戲主機及資料中心伺服器等搭載半導體的終端產品，都可能納入課稅範圍。
美方同時考慮依企業在美國規劃的半導體產能，給予一定比例的免稅進口額度。台灣與美國先前達成的協議即提供一項參考，在美國建廠期間，企業可依規劃產能取得最高2.5倍的免稅進口額度，完工後則為1.5倍。如果類似架構擴大至其他國家，海外業者在美國投入多少產能，將直接影響未來進口晶片的關稅成本。
這也是三星電子與SK海力士近期美國投資更值得關注的原因。
SK海力士8月底已在印第安納州動工興建AI記憶體先進封裝基地，投資超過40億美元，預計2028年10月完成無塵室，並於2029年第3季量產下一代HBM4E。公司預期該基地未來產能可達每年數十萬片晶圓規模，並成為首個供應美國製HBM的重要據點。
三星電子也正在加快德州Taylor布局。第1座晶圓廠已於7月完成設備搬入，準備在2026年底前投入運轉；第2座工廠則規劃於年底啟動建設，目標2030年量產。換句話說，當美國開始討論以當地產能作為關稅減免依據時，南韓兩大記憶體廠已經先建立美國製造基礎。
南韓政府也希望進一步把這項優勢制度化。產業通商資源部長金正官表示，美韓仍在協商半導體關稅，雙方先前已有共識，南韓取得的待遇不應劣於主要競爭對手。2025年11月公布的美韓聯合事實清單也納入相關保障。
除了美國投資，三星與SK海力士本身的市場地位也提供另一層緩衝。兩家公司2026年第2季合計占全球DRAM市場約65%，在AI基礎設施投資持續推升記憶體需求之際，供應商仍握有較強議價能力。因此，即使關稅最終落地，部分成本也可能向美國大型科技客戶轉嫁，而非完全由晶片製造商自行吸收。
這使美國半導體關稅出現一個微妙的政策平衡。華府希望透過關稅迫使更多晶片產能移往美國，但短期內AI資料中心仍需要大量亞洲供應的HBM、DRAM及先進晶片。如果關稅過高，不僅可能增加美國AI基礎設施成本，也可能讓本土大型科技公司的晶片採購承受更大壓力。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – The Trump administration is preparing a new round of semiconductor tariffs, shifting policy focus from targeted measures on specific advanced chips earlier this year to a broader range covering more semiconductors and end‑products that embed chips. For Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) and SK Hynix (000660‑KR), it is noteworthy that the United States is considering tying tariff relief to local manufacturing investment, and both companies have already positioned U.S. capacity, which could become a key bargaining chip for the South Korean government in negotiations with Washington to secure tariff concessions and mitigate impact.

U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick recently said the Trump administration is crafting a more targeted and carefully considered semiconductor tariff policy. The core of the policy is emerging: companies that invest in U.S. manufacturing could earn tariff benefits, while firms without U.S. capacity may face higher import costs.

Compared with the 25% tariff imposed in January 2026 on certain advanced compute chips and related products, the next phase may cover a wider scope, potentially including laptops, gaming consoles and data‑center servers that incorporate semiconductors.

U.S. officials are also weighing a system that grants a certain proportion of duty‑free import allowances based on a company’s planned semiconductor capacity in the United States. The Taiwan‑U.S. agreement provides a reference: during plant construction, firms can obtain duty‑free import quotas up to 2.5 times their planned capacity, dropping to 1.5 times after completion. If a similar framework is extended to other countries, the amount of capacity foreign firms invest in the U.S. will directly affect future chip import tariff costs.
This is why recent U.S. investments by Samsung and SK Hynix deserve close attention.

SK Hynix broke ground at the end of August in Indiana for an AI‑memory advanced packaging facility, investing over $4 billion. The cleanroom is slated for completion in October 2028, with mass production of the next‑generation HBM4E expected in Q3 2029. The company expects the site to eventually handle several hundred thousand wafers per year and become the first major supplier of U.S.-made HBM.

Samsung is also accelerating its Texas Taylor site. The first fab completed equipment moves in July and is set to start operation by the end of 2026; a second plant is planned to break ground by year‑end with a target of volume production in 2030. In other words, as the U.S. begins to discuss using domestic capacity as a basis for tariff reductions, the two South Korean memory giants have already laid the manufacturing groundwork in America.

South Korea’s government wants to further institutionalize this advantage. Trade and Industry Minister Kim Jung‑kwan said South Korea and the U.S. are still negotiating semiconductor tariffs, and both sides have previously agreed that South Korea’s treatment should not be inferior to that of major competitors. The U.S.–Korea joint fact‑sheet released in November 2025 also includes related protections.

Beyond U.S. investment, Samsung and SK Hynix’s market positions provide an additional buffer. The two firms together held about 65% of the global DRAM market in Q2 2026, and as AI‑infrastructure spending continues to boost memory demand, suppliers retain strong bargaining power. Consequently, even if tariffs are implemented, some costs may be passed on to large U.S. tech customers rather than being fully absorbed by chip makers.

This creates a subtle policy balance for U.S. semiconductor tariffs. Washington hopes tariffs will push more chip capacity to the United States, yet in the short term AI data centers still rely heavily on Asian‑supplied HBM, DRAM and advanced chips. If tariffs are set too high, they could raise the cost of U.S. AI infrastructure and increase pressure on domestic tech firms’ chip procurement budgets.

items.title: 2017年來頭一遭！大摩：今年全球銅礦產量恐下滑 銅價前景獲提振
paras: 過去一年銅價屢創新高，主因是關稅預期催生的搬倉；如今多頭把賭注轉向生產端，因銅礦供應增速近乎停擺。
根據國際銅業研究組織(ICSG)最新數據，今年上半年全球銅礦產量年減1.1%；智利Codelco與Freeport-McMoRan均見兩位數降幅。
今年初，摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)原先估計供應將有所成長，目前則下修為「基本持平或微降」，這意味著全球銅礦可能出現2017年來首度年度下滑。
理論上，高價應誘使礦企增產，但品位下滑、工安事故、專案延誤與極端天氣層層卡關。智利第二大礦商銅產量降至19年來同期新低，Cochilco連兩季下修全年預測至年減 2.6%，Codelco 更坦言連「小幅增長」都難達標。
貝萊德主題投資主管Evy Hambro上月受訪時直言，老礦品位掉、資產老化、新專案斷檔，是銅市「非常、非常緊張」的主要原因。
但精煉銅並未缺貨，市場炒作美國可能對精煉銅加稅，空前規模的銅搬至美國倉庫，區域失衡加劇。這種搬倉屬暫時現象，但生產端制約是結構性的，多頭看好受限的供給終將再推高銅價。
專家指出，短期看，美倉虹吸與智利天氣擾動主導波動；中線來看，大摩翻空、Codelco連降指引，已把「礦緊」寫進定價，而電氣化與AI基礎建設若持續吃銅，價格則將易漲難跌。

items.title: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok一度集體當機 持續近4小時
items.title_en: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Simultaneously Went Offline for Nearly Four Hours
paras: 本次三大AI模型當機時間持續約3小時40分，截至台灣時間4日（周五）凌晨1點10分，所有服務已經恢復，Gemini在這次事件中從未通報服務中斷。
此前，Downdetector上用戶通報以及各公司狀態頁面顯示，多家AI公司的服務中斷。
Anthropic表示，正在調查Claude出現的錯誤，並致力於修復。OpenAI說，ChatGPT和Codex出現問題。SpaceXAI稱，Grok出現故障，正在調查服務中斷。

雖然AI服務當機不算罕見，但三家巨頭平台同時出現故障並不尋常。
目前來看，Gemini未受影響。儘管在同一時間段內用戶通報數量有所上升，但Google尚未確認服務中斷。
底層原因可能與微軟(MSFT-US) Azure有關，該平台同樣出現了故障通報激增的情況。這三家AI平台均依賴Azure提供雲端運算服務，不過它們的算力架構中也包含了Google等其他服務商。
paras_en: The three major AI models were down for about 3 hours and 40 minutes; by 1:10 a.m. Taiwan time on the 4th (Friday), all services had been restored, and Gemini did not report any service interruption during this incident.
Previously, user reports on Downdetector and status pages from various companies indicated that several AI services were disrupted.
Anthropic said it was investigating an error with Claude and working to fix it. OpenAI reported issues with ChatGPT and Codex. SpaceXAI stated that Grok had a fault and was investigating the outage.
Downdetector data showed over 12,000 user reports indicating problems with OpenAI. About 1,200 reports concerned Claude, and roughly 1,000 reports were about Grok.
While AI service outages are not uncommon, it is unusual for three major platforms to fail simultaneously.
Gemini appears to have been unaffected. Although the number of user reports increased during the same period, Google has not confirmed a service interruption.

The underlying cause may be related to Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure, which also saw a surge in outage reports. All three AI platforms rely on Azure for cloud computing, though their compute architectures also include other providers such as Google.

items.title: USD/JPY：市場押注日本央行升息，日圓強勢升至一個月高點、美元兌日圓跌破157
items.title_en: USD/JPY: Market Bets on BOJ Rate Hikes, Yen Rallies to One-Month High, Dollar/Yen Falls Below 157
paras: 要點：

日圓強勢反彈，這次是真的嗎？
市場升息押注大幅升溫
接下來聚焦美國就業數據


日圓在兩個交易日內從1美元兌逾160日圓，大幅升值至約157日圓。接下來，週五公布的美國就業報告，將決定這波日圓反轉行情是否還有進一步的上漲空間。

日圓終於找到上漲動能


週四，usdjpy大跌1%，跌破157.00日圓，創下約一個月來最低水準。
日圓週三上漲約0.9%，讓原本看似又一次守住160日圓失敗的走勢，轉變為更值得關注的兩個交易日反轉行情。
日圓近期一度觸及164日圓附近的40年低點，之後美日罕見聯合干預，推動USD/JPY最低跌至155.20日圓。不過，這波漲勢後來大多數又遭到回吐。
從目前情況來看，最新一波日圓漲勢似乎是由利率預期轉變所支撐，而不只是政府拋售美元的結果。
稍早市場曾猜測日本當局再次進場干預，或進行「利率檢查」 — 也就是官員向銀行詢問即時匯率報價，有時會在正式進場干預市場前進行。
不過，分析師如今愈來愈傾向將這波走勢歸因於日本央行偏鷹派的訊號。這一次，日圓可能真的找到了自己的上漲燃料。


日本央行進一步轉向鷹派


日本央行審議委員高田創表示，利率應根據通膨情況靈活升調，而不是遵循可預測的每年兩次升息時程。
日本央行總裁植田和男則表示，經濟與物價風險將在9月會議上進行討論，這也意味著每一次政策會議都可能成為升息的時機。
市場目前幾乎已完全反映日本央行本月升息的預期，並預計截至年底前將累計升息約50個基點。
1個基點等於百分之一個百分點。日本兩年期政府公債殖利率週三升至1.83%，創1995年以來最高。
日本殖利率上升，會降低套利交易的吸引力 — 也就是以低利率借入日圓，再投資於殖利率較高的海外資產。
如果日本央行加快升息腳步，這類部位的獲利空間就會縮小，交易員可能因此平倉，進而被迫買回日圓。全球最受歡迎的融資貨幣，現在開始收取「入場費」了。


美國非農就業數據將決定另一邊的走向


週五公布的美國就業報告預計將顯示新增就業人數約56,000人。目前市場認為聯準會9月升息的機率約為60%。如果就業數據疲弱，升息預期可能降溫，美國公債殖利率下滑，進而推動USD/JPY進一步走低。
如果非農就業與薪資成長強勁，則可能支持聯準會主席Kevin Warsh的鷹派立場，並可能推動USD/JPY回升至159甚至160日圓。
目前的匯率走勢，本質上是兩種利率預期重新定價的角力：一方面是日本央行加快緊縮政策，另一方面則是聯準會可能再次升息。
目前值得關注的價位：157日圓是短線關鍵樞軸，其下方則關注156日圓附近的支撐，以及干預後的低點155.20日圓。
上方阻力則位於159與160日圓。若跌破157.50日圓，將進一步強化日圓的看跌美元／看漲日圓反轉走勢；若重新站回160日圓，則代表日圓這波反攻仍需要官方出手「助攻」。


#TradingView
paras_en: Key points:

The yen has rebounded strongly – is this time genuine? Market bets on rate hikes are heating up, and the focus now shifts to U.S. employment data. The yen appreciated sharply from over ¥160 per dollar to around ¥157 within two trading days. The upcoming U.S. jobs report on Friday will determine whether this yen reversal has further upside potential.

The yen finally found upward momentum. On Thursday, USD/JPY dropped 1% below ¥157, hitting its lowest level in about a month. After a 0.9% rise on Wednesday, the yen turned a seemingly failed defense of the ¥160 level into a notable two‑day reversal. The yen had earlier touched the 40‑year low near ¥164, prompting a rare joint intervention by the U.S. and Japan that pushed USD/JPY down to ¥155.20, though most of the rally was later given back. The latest yen rise appears driven by shifting rate expectations rather than merely government dollar sales. Earlier speculation that Japanese authorities might intervene again or conduct a “rate check” (officials asking banks for real‑time quotes before formal intervention) is giving way to analysts attributing the move to hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan. This time the yen may have truly found its fuel.
The Bank of Japan is turning more hawkish. Governor Kazuo Ueda’s deputy, Takada Sō, said rates should be adjusted flexibly according to inflation rather than following a predictable twice‑a‑year hike schedule. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda noted that economic and price risks will be discussed at the September meeting, meaning each policy meeting could become a rate‑hike opportunity. The market has almost fully priced in a rate hike this month and expects about 50 basis points of cumulative hikes by year‑end. One basis point equals one‑hundredth of a percent. Japan’s two‑year government bond yield rose to 1.83% on Wednesday, the highest since 1995. Higher Japanese yields reduce the appeal of carry trades—borrowing yen at low rates to invest in higher‑yielding overseas assets. If the BOJ accelerates hikes, the profit space for such positions shrinks, prompting traders to unwind and buy back yen, turning the world’s favorite funding currency into one that now carries an “entry fee”.
U.S. non‑farm payrolls will decide the other side’s direction. Friday’s U.S. jobs report is expected to show about 56,000 new jobs. The market currently sees a roughly 60% chance of a Fed rate hike in September. Weak employment data could cool hike expectations, lower U.S. bond yields, and push USD/JPY further down. Strong payrolls and wage growth could support Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish stance and lift USD/JPY back to ¥159 or even ¥160. The current exchange‑rate move essentially reflects a re‑pricing battle between two rate expectations: a faster BOJ tightening versus a possible further Fed hike. Key levels to watch: ¥157 is a short‑term pivot, with support near ¥156 and the post‑intervention low of ¥155.20. Resistance lies at ¥159‑¥160. A break below ¥157.50 would reinforce a bearish USD/long‑yen reversal, while a return to ¥160 would suggest the yen’s rally still needs official “assist”.

items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Falls, Bond Market Sell‑off Cools, Yen Surges to One‑Month High
paras: 美元周四(3日)下跌，創逾兩周來最差單日表現，主要因美國公債殖利率下滑及日元強勁反彈。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.7%，報98.91。
美國公債殖利率下滑拖累美元。交易員在美債經歷一波劇烈拋售後開始逢低買進，帶動殖利率回落。美國10年期公債殖利率周二升至2023年11月以來最高，周四最新下跌3.3個基點至4.761%。
固定收益市場近期的拋售潮，主要受到多項因素推動，包括高油價引發的通膨疑慮、企業為建置AI基礎設施而大舉舉債可能造成的債務不可持續疑慮，以及政府財政債務持續膨脹。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)釋出的一些正面訊息，也有助於改善市場情緒。
華勒在接受Reuters NEXT訪問時準備的談話稿中表示，「雖然通膨仍明顯高於聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)設定的2%目標，但近期數據顯示，我們終於看到一些通膨降溫的跡象。如果未來兩周公布的數據持續呈現這種趨勢，我將傾向支持維持聯邦資金利率目前的水準。」
這名FOMC投票委員補充，他認為潛在通膨的表現其實遠優於核心通膨數據所呈現的情況。相較於聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行會議上的演講，華勒此次發言的語氣較不偏鷹。
Macquarie外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「如果目前主要央行再次形成一個共同趨勢，那就是貨幣政策應對供給衝擊引發的新一波通膨保持戒心。這可能是過去兩周聯準會、歐洲央行(ECB)、澳洲央行(RBA)、加拿大央行(BoC)及日本銀行紛紛採取較為鷹派立場時，最明確且最普遍的考量因素。」
「如果所有央行同時轉向鷹派，對外匯市場的影響仍難以確定。但在油價高漲的背景下，我們仍偏好美元相較於澳幣、歐元及英鎊的表現，原因在於稀缺石油的貿易條件優勢有利於美國。」
日元飆至1個月高點
日元周四成為外匯市場焦點。日元強勁反彈，兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日當局歷史性聯手干預匯市僅數日。包括這次具里程碑意義的聯合干預在內，日本從7月30日至8月26日合計動用創紀錄的15兆日元來支撐日元。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160日元兌1美元，這被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
布魯金斯研究院資深經濟研究員Robin Brooks表示，「日元隔夜的升值走勢具干預的所有典型特徵：日元急劇、垂直式升值，但日美利差並未同步擴大，無法從水準面解釋這樣的升幅。如果看起來像干預，那就是干預。」
除了可能的干預行動之外，本周日本銀行(BoJ)決策官員釋出的偏鷹訊號，也為日元提供支撐。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周日在北卡羅來納州舉行的G20會議期間，與日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會面。貝森特當時「強烈支持日本採取果斷的市場與貨幣政策措施，以因應日元被大幅低估的問題」。
植田周二在一場會議上證實，日銀將在9月討論升息，此外，日銀委員高田創(Hajime Takata)進一步強化市場的升息預期，主張採取更靈活的升息路徑。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.4%，至1.1632美元。
即使歐盟統計局(Eurostat)公布數據顯示，歐元區7月工業生產者價格月增1.6%，歐元仍持續走高。這與6月月減0.3%的表現形成反差。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 3rd), posting its worst single‑day performance in over two weeks, mainly due to a drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a strong rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.7% to 98.91.

Falling U.S. Treasury yields weighed on the dollar. After a sharp sell‑off in Treasuries, traders began buying on dips, pushing yields lower. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield, which had risen on Tuesday to its highest since November 2023, fell 3.3 basis points on Thursday to 4.761%.

The recent bond‑market sell‑off has been driven by several factors, including inflation worries sparked by high oil prices, concerns that corporate borrowing to build AI infrastructure could become unsustainable, and the continued expansion of government fiscal debt.
Positive remarks from Fed Governor Christopher Waller also helped improve market sentiment.

In a prepared statement for a Reuters NEXT interview, Waller said, "Although inflation remains clearly above the Federal Open Market Committee’s 2% target, recent data show that we are finally seeing some signs of cooling. If the data released over the next two weeks continue this trend, I would be inclined to support keeping the federal funds rate at its current level."

The voting FOMC member added that he believes underlying inflation is actually performing far better than core‑inflation figures suggest. Compared with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting last week, Waller’s tone was less hawkish.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, "If the major central banks are again forming a common trend, it is that monetary policy should remain cautious toward a new wave of inflation triggered by supply shocks. This has been the clearest and most common consideration over the past two weeks as the Fed, ECB, RBA, BoC and BOJ have all taken relatively hawkish stances."

"If all central banks turn hawkish at the same time, the impact on FX markets is still uncertain. But against a backdrop of high oil prices, we still prefer the dollar over the Australian, euro and pound, because the trade‑flow advantage of scarce oil benefits the United States," he added.
The yen surged to a one‑month high

The yen became the focus of the FX market on Thursday, rallying sharply and briefly reaching 155.30 per dollar, the highest level since August 3, just days after historic joint intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities. Including this landmark coordinated intervention, Japan used a record 15 trillion yen from July 30 to August 26 to support the currency.

Earlier this week the yen had slipped past 160 per dollar, a level viewed by Tokyo as a key threshold for intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation among investors was rampant.

Brookings senior economist Robin Brooks said, "The yen’s overnight appreciation shows all the hallmarks of intervention: a rapid, vertical move while the U.S.–Japan rate differential did not widen, making the rise impossible to explain on fundamentals alone. If it looks like intervention, it is intervention."
In addition to possible intervention, hawkish signals from Bank of Japan policymakers this week also gave the yen support.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda during the G20 meeting in North Carolina on Sunday. Bessent said he "strongly supports Japan taking decisive market and monetary‑policy actions to address the yen’s significant undervaluation."

Ueda confirmed on Tuesday at a meeting that the BOJ will discuss a rate hike in September, and BOJ board member Hajime Takata further reinforced market expectations for tightening, advocating a more flexible path for future hikes.
Among other major currencies, the euro rose 0.4% against the dollar to $1.1632.
Even though Eurostat data showed a 1.6% month‑on‑month increase in July industrial producer prices in the euro area, the euro kept climbing, contrasting with a 0.3% decline in June.
Markets are awaiting the European Central Bank’s rate decision next week, with consensus expecting a 25‑basis‑point hike.
The Canadian dollar strengthened versus the dollar, with the USD/CAD pair down 0.4% at 1.3787.
